operator_priority.least_relaxation_rationale: V13 changes the acceptance oracle, not the established four-bit representation. It preserves all 168 sealed V10 transformer tensors and adopts only the isolated V12 lm_head improvement, retaining exact byte accounting, packed Scale24, grouped Dynamic Scale32, the 128-bit memory boundary, and the unchanged ace2_shell public contract.

weight_policy.payload_semantics: unsigned four-bit index into the authenticated selected signed-Q4.4 codebook bank
weight_policy.payload_packing: two indices per byte, low nibble first
weight_policy.transformer_source: exact sealed V10 packed-Scale24 dual-bank per-row-selector representation
weight_policy.transformer_reconstruction_rule: every payload, packed Scale24 row, dual codebook bank, selector bit, alignment byte, and reconstructed BF16 tensor must exactly equal the sealed V10 record

activation_policy.payload: signed int8 with symmetric legal values -127 through 127; -128 is reserved and forbidden

generation_contract.chat_template: exact selected Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct template with add_generation_prompt=true
generation_contract.multi_turn_messages: one system message followed by alternating user and candidate-assistant messages, ending in a user message; each generated assistant answer is appended before the next turn
generation_contract.decode: deterministic greedy argmax with no sampling
generation_contract.visible_terminator_policy: record the terminating token but omit it from decoded user-visible text

single_turn_cases.required_observable: equation is equivalent to 12*3-5 and final answer is 31

single_turn_cases.required_observable: readable Rayleigh-scattering explanation in exactly three sentences without equations
